notes.subject: yu harim
notes.rationale: Sema Yisrael — singaut bilong harim, i bilumbim olgeta man long nem.

notes.subject: to Yisrael
notes.rationale: Tok i go daun stret long Yisrael.

notes.subject: Yahwe i wanpela
notes.rationale: אחד: 'wanpela tasol' (wan God nomo) o 'wankain/yunait'; Tok Pisin 'wanpela tasol' i holim Mining wan-God tasol.

notes.subject: ⟨em i⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i nidim predikit 'i', Hebri i nogat kopula.

translation: Yisrael, yu harim: Yahwe, Elohim bilong yumi — Yahwe, em i wanpela tasol.
